reason: Hypothesis B is more physically sound for refractory HEAs under fusion conditions: Ni is a well-known electron-conductivity enhancer in metallic alloys, whereas Co's mechanism for boosting thermal transport in BCC refractory HEAs is less established and may not translate from the CoCrFeNiCu FCC system. B also provides a more specific, testable prediction (20–30% improvement) and a clearer falsification experiment tied to the baseline (CrFeTiTa)70W30 alloy from the cited prior work.
